mapper.select: SELECT smr.*, ( SELECT v.meaning AS value_name FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'SMS_MESSAGE_TYPE' AND v.code_value = smr.message_type ) AS MESSAGE_TYPE_n, ( SELECT hm.bp_name AS value_name FROM HLS_BP_MASTER hm WHERE hm.BP_CATEGORY = 'MANUFACTURER' AND hm.bp_id = smr.rule_n1 ) AS RULE_N1_n, ( SELECT hm.bp_name AS value_name FROM HLS_BP_MASTER hm WHERE hm.BP_CATEGORY = 'VENDER' AND hm.bp_id = smr.rule_n2 ) AS RULE_N2_n, ( SELECT hbt.DESCRIPTION AS value_name FROM HLS_BUSINESS_TYPE hbt WHERE hbt.DOCUMENT_CATEGORY = 'HLS_BP_MASTER' AND hbt.business_type = smr.rule_v1 ) AS RULE_V1_n, ( SELECT sc.meaning AS value_name FROM sys_code_value_b_v sc WHERE sc.code = 'CON.CONTRACT_STATUS' AND sc.code_value = smr.rule_v2 ) AS RULE_V2_n, ( SELECT sc.meaning AS value_name FROM sys_code_value_b_v sc WHERE sc.code = 'SYS.YES_NO' AND sc.code_value = smr.rule_v3 ) AS RULE_V3_n, ( SELECT smt.DESCRIPTION AS value_name FROM SYS_MESSAGE_TEMPLATE smt WHERE smt.template_id = smr.rule_n4 ) AS RULE_N4_n FROM sys_message_rule smr ORDER BY smr.message_type, smr.rule_code
select * from sys_message_rule smr where smr.message_type='PHONE_MESSAGE'
select * from sys_message_rule smr where smr.message_type='WECHAT_MESSAGE'
